import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Define the query to fetch hourly AQHI data for station_id 15 from 2025-01-20 to 2025-01-26
query = text("""
SELECT datetime, aqhi
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 15
AND datetime >= '2025-01-20 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-01-27 00:00:00'
ORDER BY datetime
""")

# Execute the query and load the results into a DataFrame
aqhi_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Print the number of rows in the DataFrame
print(f"Number of rows: {len(aqhi_df)}")

# Calculate the mean hourly AQHI for weekdays (2025-01-20 to 2025-01-24)
weekday_aqhi_df = aqhi_df[(aqhi_df['datetime'].dt.date >= pd.to_datetime('2025-01-20').date()) & 
                         (aqhi_df['datetime'].dt.date <= pd.to_datetime('2025-01-24').date())]
weekday_mean_aqhi = weekday_aqhi_df['aqhi'].mean()

# Calculate the mean hourly AQHI for the weekend (2025-01-25 to 2025-01-26)
weekend_aqhi_df = aqhi_df[(aqhi_df['datetime'].dt.date >= pd.to_datetime('2025-01-25').date()) & 
                         (aqhi_df['datetime'].dt.date <= pd.to_datetime('2025-01-26').date())]
weekend_mean_aqhi = weekend_aqhi_df['aqhi'].mean()

# Print the results
print(f"Weekday mean AQHI: {weekday_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
print(f"Weekend mean AQHI: {weekend_mean_aqhi:.2f}")
